WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes,
    COUNT(*) as num_observatories
  FROM telescope_counts
)
SELECT 
  tc.observstation,
  tc.telescope_count,
  tc.telescope_count::NUMERIC / totals.total_telescopes as share,
  (tc.telescope_count::NUMERIC / totals.total_telescopes) - (1.0 / totals.num_observatories) as difference
FROM telescope_counts tc
CROSS JOIN totals
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
